description: Upcoming U.S. Treasury auctions of seized/forfeited real property (official treasury.gov list): property type, address, state, ZIP, sale method (online auction or broker sale), auction date (null while 'coming soon'), Treasury sale number, short description (size, rooms, lot) and detail-page URL. Filter by state or property type. Replaces Auction.com, which blocks automated access. Usually answers in about 6 s, up to 15 s on slower calls; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_auction_com_property when you need HUD homes for sale by online bid in a US state or city; realestate_zillow_rentals_scraper_ppe when you need typical market rent for a US ZIP code from the Zillow. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state code, e.g. TX

type.description: Optional words of the property type, e.g. single family, commercial, land
